ValidationRule.description: Blocks forward stage-skipping (e.g. Consider to Select). Backward moves to any earlier stage are always allowed. Closed Lost is exempt in both directions (set directly by AF_FL_Opp_LostApproved from any stage).
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISCHANGED(StageName), NOT(ISPICKVAL(StageName, "Closed Lost")), NOT(ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(StageName), "Closed Lost")), ( CASE(TEXT(StageName), "Consider", 0, "Explore", 1, "Select", 2, "Commit", 3, "Take the Keys", 4, "Closed Won", 5, -1) - CASE(TEXT(PRIORVALUE(StageName)), "Consider", 0, "Explore", 1, "Select", 2, "Commit", 3, "Take the Keys", 4, "Closed Won", 5, -1) ) > 1 )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Stage cannot skip ahead — move the Opportunity through each stage in order. Moving back to an earlier stage is always allowed, and Closed Lost can be set from any stage.
